description: This Java source file defines the class DefaultPersistenceStreamingActor, a final class extending AbstractPersistenceStreamingActor, used in the context of persistence and streaming in a MongoDB-backed Akka actor system. It provides factory methods to create Props for Akka actors and manages entity class and mapping functions.

classes.name: DefaultPersistenceStreamingActor
classes.description: A final class implementing an Akka actor that streams persisted entities of type T from MongoDB. It extends AbstractPersistenceStreamingActor and provides factory methods for actor creation with entity mapping functions.

methods.name: props
methods.description: Creates Props for an Akka actor of type DefaultPersistenceStreamingActor with specified entity class and mapping functions.

methods.name: propsForTests
methods.description: Creates Props for testing purposes, allowing injection of a custom MongoReadJournal instance.

methods.name: getElementClass
methods.description: Returns the entity class type parameter used by this actor.
